text.en:
1. This Act may be cited as The Titular Superior of the Institute

of the Marist Brothers of the Schools (Incorporation) Act 1958.

Interpretation

2. In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires—

"Corporation" means The Titular Superior of the Institute

of the Marist Brothers of the Schools, Peninsular Malaysia, as

incorporated under section 3;

"successors in office" includes the Brother Procurator of the

Institute of the Marist Brothers of the Schools, Peninsular Malaysia,

when the office of the Titular Superior becomes vacant by the

resignation or death of the holder of the office of the Titular

Superior until the formal assumption of office by a successor.
6 Laws of Malaysia

Incorporation of The Titular Superior of the Institute of the

Marist Brothers of the Schools in Peninsular Malaysia

3. (1) The Reverend Brother Robbe, the Titular Superior of the

Institute of the Marist Brothers of the Schools, Malaya, and his

successors in office, shall be a body corporate by the name of

"The Titular Superior of the Institute of the Marist Brothers of

the Schools, Federation of Malaya" and shall have perpetual

succession and a common seal.

(2) The Corporation may sue and be sued in its name.

(3) The Corporation may—

(a) enter into contracts;

(b) acquire, purchase, take, hold and enjoy movable and

immovable property of every description upon such

terms as the Corporation thinks fit; and

(c) sell, convey, assign, exchange, surrender, yield up, mortgage,

demise, reassign, transfer or otherwise dispose of any

movable or immovable property vested in the corporation

upon such terms as the corporation thinks fit.

Common seal

4. (1) The Corporation shall have a common seal which may

be broken, changed, altered and made anew as the Corporation

thinks fit.

(2) All deeds, documents and other instruments requiring

the seal of the Corporation shall be sealed with the seal of the

Corporation in the presence of—

(a) the Titular Superior;

(b) when the office of the Titular Superior is vacant, the

Brother Procurator; or

(c) the attorney of the Titular Superior or the Brother Procurator

duly authorized by a power of attorney deposited pursuant

to section 4 of the Powers of Attorney Act 1949 [Act 424].

Act 886
The Titular Superior of the Institute of the

Marist Brothers of the Schools (Incorporation)

(3) All deeds, documents and other instruments duly sealed

under subsection (2) shall be signed by the Titular Superior, the

Brother Procurator or the attorney so authorized, as the case may

be.

(4) The signing of the deed, document or other instrument shall

be sufficient evidence of the due sealing of the deed, document or

other instrument and the seal is the lawful seal of the Corporation.

Appointment of successor to Titular Superior

5. The appointment of a new Titular Superior in the event of

death or for any other reason shall be made by the General Board

of Administration of the Institute of the Marist Brothers of the

Schools of St. Genis-Laval, Rhone, France.

Notification of appointment of Titular Superior

6. A notification in the Gazette of the appointment of any person—

(a) to the office of the Titular Superior or Brother Procurator

of the Institute of the Marist Brothers of the Schools in

Peninsular Malaysia; or

(b) to officiate as such Titular Superior or Brother Procurator,

shall be conclusive evidence that such person is duly authorized

to exercise the powers conferred on the Titular Superior or the

Brother Procurator, as the case may be, under this Act.

Vesting of property

7. All movable and immovable property situated in Peninsular

Malaysia held, for and by, conveyed, assigned, granted, leased,

transferred, transmitted to or otherwise vested in the Institute or

in the Titular Superior or any other office holder of the Institute

is vested in the Corporation for the respective estates and interest

for which the same is held.
8 Laws of Malaysia

Corporation to have office in Peninsular Malaysia

8. (1) The Corporation shall have an office in Peninsular Malaysia.

(2) The address of the office and any subsequent change of

address shall be notified to the Minister who is responsible for

education in Peninsular Malaysia, and particulars of the address

shall be published in the Gazette.
